payload.core_composition_summary: The solution uses a single greedy mechanism: it computes prefix sums to track extremes, then applies a greedy condition to decide possible reduction in one dimension, choosing the better one.
payload.rationale: Prefix sums are just preprocessing, not a separate algorithmic mechanism. The core logic is a greedy rule based on extremal hits pattern. No DP, complete search, or advanced data structures are used; thus it's a single-mechanism algorithm.
